name: calibration-one-refusal-50
description: A small evaluation suite that measures a model's calibration to refuse unsafe or inappropriate requests; contains 50 prompts designed to elicit a correct refusal. It assesses whether models produce appropriate refusal responses and how reliably they do so across similar prompts. Useful for measuring refusal consistency and basic safety-alignment behavior.
reputation: A niche safety/calibration dataset used in alignment research and internal evaluations, with limited broad adoption.
